# BMAD Fast Kit Orchestrator

Fast Kit workflow coordinator for the BMAD framework. Manages a streamlined delivery workflow optimised for speed and small-team projects.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/fast/orchestrator.md`](../../agents/fast/orchestrator.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-fast-orchestrator start fast workflow for [project description]
@bmad-fast-orchestrator what is the next step?
@bmad-fast-orchestrator summarise current fast-kit status
```
